name: Three-Vertex Path
definition: The path with vertex sequence $v_0v_1v_2$; equivalently, the subgraph of $Q_2$ induced by $\{00,10,11\}$.
properties: It is a partial cube, median graph, maximum class, daisy cube, and learning-space graph, but it is not a hypercube because it has three vertices. Every proper pc-minor is $K_1$ or $K_2$ and hence a hypercube.
